bio.text: Matt Hatchett was elected to Georgia House District 155 in November 2010 and has chaired the House Appropriations Committee since December 2022.
He was born and raised in Dublin, Georgia, and holds a B.S. in Applied Mathematics from Presbyterian College.
He worked for Delta Air Lines starting in 1988, owned a dry cleaning business in Dublin until 2010, and served on the Dublin City Council from 1999 to 2009.
